selection_reason: A disperses short topic tokens into the negative spaces and margins with varied scale and angle while preserving the journal-page R. B puts most secondary tokens in a more regular line on the diagonal paper stroke.
visual_encoding: Topics only; scale, position, color and underlines do not encode scientific values, causal relationships or quantity of coverage.
method: Built-in image_gen; two edits of previous selected source; no artistic postprocessing. Production exports resize only.
small_size_limit: 180px topic text checked separately; 64px partial reading only; 32/16px rely on R silhouette, no guarantee that all topic words remain readable.
